verdict.rationale: Insomnia's background automation comes through the Inso CLI. The CLI is documented to run headless in CI with prompts disabled and pass/fail exit codes, and it can automate collection test runs within Git workflows. Scheduling and background execution are left to external CI systems, not built into Insomnia. missing for 10: native scheduled or background runs inside Insomnia, AI- or agent-driven autonomous automations, monitoring and alerting of unattended runs, independent hands-on corroboration.
